scope: The principal Kykkos Monastery compound on the Troodos mountainside, including the arcaded courts, main church, campanile and adjoining museum range, in its 2009 documented appearance.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: Locates the Holy Monastery in Troodos; the audio guide distinguishes the nearby 1,318 m Throni summit from the monastery. The original elevation used by the model is at the mapped building.
Identifies the flagstone lower court, well, connected ranges, the stone domed basilica and the 1882 belfry.
Describes the rebuilt monastery museum and its chapel-like interior. The museum objects are outside the architectural model.
A geolocated 2022 field collection at 34.98375, 32.74145 identifies Kykkos Monastery at about 1,130 m.

authoredComponents.name: Stone gallery tiers and lower well court
